ayahs.1: Tamaam tareefen usi Allah ke liye sazawaar hain jis ne apne bande par yeh Quran utaara aur is mein koi kasar baaqi na chhodi.
ayahs.2: Balke har tarah se theek thaak rakha taake apne paas ki sakht saza se hoshiyaar karde aur imaan laane aur nek amal karne walon ko khushkhabriyan suna de ke un ke liye behtareen badla hai.
ayahs.3: Jis mein woh hamesha hamesha rahenge.
ayahs.4: Aur un logon ko bhi dara de jo kehte hain ke Allah Taala aulaad rakhta hai.
ayahs.5: Dar-haqeeqat na to khud unhen is ka ilm hai na un ke baap daadon ko. Yeh tohmat badi buri hai jo un ke munh se nikal rahi hai, woh nira jhoot bak rahe hain.
ayahs.6: Pas agar yeh log is baat par imaan na laayen to kya aap un ke peechhe isi ranj mein apni jaan halaak kar daalen ge?
ayahs.7: Roo-e-zameen par jo kuchh hai hum ne use zameen ki raunaq ka baais banaya hai ke hum unhen aazmaen ke un mein se kaun nek aamaal wala hai.
ayahs.8: Is par jo kuchh hai hum use ek hamwaar saaf maidan kar daalne wale hain.
ayahs.9: Kya tu apne khayaal mein ghaar aur katbe walon ko hamari nishaaniyon mein se koi bahut ajeeb nishani samajh raha hai?
ayahs.10: In chand naujawaanon ne jab ghaar mein panah li to dua ki ke aye hamare parwardigar! Hamein apne paas se rahmat ata farma aur hamare kaam mein hamare liye raah-yaabi ko aasan karde.
ayahs.11: Pas hum ne un ke kaanon par ginti ke kayi saal tak isi ghaar mein parde daal diye.
ayahs.12: Phir hum ne unhen utha khada kiya ke hum yeh maloom karlen ke donon giroh mein se is intihaai muddat ko jo unhon ne guzaari kis ne ziyada yaad rakhi hai.
ayahs.13: Hum un ka saheeh waaqia tere saamne bayan farma rahe hain. Yeh chand naujawaan apne Rabb par imaan laaye the aur hum ne un ki hidayat mein taraqqi di thi.
ayahs.14: Hum ne un ke dil mazboot kardiye the jab ke yeh uth khade hue aur kehne lage ke hamara parwardigar to wahi hai jo aasman-o-zameen ka parwardigar hai, na-mumkin hai ke hum is ke siwa kisi aur mabood ko pukaren, agar aisa kiya to hum ne nihaayat hi ghalat baat kahi.
ayahs.15: Yeh hai hamari qaum jis ne is ke siwa aur mabood bana rakhe hain. In ke ilaah hone ki yeh koi saaf daleel kyun pesh nahin karte, Allah par jhoot iftira baandhne wale se ziyada zaalim kaun hai?
ayahs.16: Jab ke tum un se aur Allah ke siwa un ke aur maboodon se kinaara-kash hogaye to ab tum kisi ghaar mein ja baitho, tumhara Rabb tum par apni rahmat phaila dega aur tumhare liye tumhare kaam mein sahoolat muhayya karde ga.
ayahs.17: Aap dekhen ge ke aftab ba-waqt-e-tuloo un ke ghaar se daayen jaanib ko jhuk jaata hai aur ba-waqt-e-ghuroob un ke baayen jaanib katra jaata hai aur woh is ghaar ki kushaada jagah mein hain. Yeh Allah ki nishaaniyon mein se hai. Allah Taala jis ki rahbari farmaaye woh raah-e-raast par hai aur jise woh gumraah karde na-mumkin hai ke aap is ka koi kaarsaaz aur rahnuma pa saken.
ayahs.18: Aap khayaal karte ke woh bedaar hain, halaanke woh soye hue the, khud hum hi unhen daayen baayen karwaten dilaya karte the, un ka kutta bhi chaukhat par apne haath phailaaye hue tha. Agar aap jhaank kar unhen dekhna chahte to zaroor ulte paaon bhaag khade hote aur un ke rob se aap par dahshat chha jaati.
ayahs.19: Isi tarah hum ne unhen jaga kar utha diya ke aapas mein poochh-gachh karlen. Ek kehne wale ne kaha ke kyun bhai tum kitni der thehre rahe? Unhon ne jawab diya ke ek din ya ek din se bhi kam. Kehne lage ke tumhare thehre rehne ka ba-khoobi ilm Allah Taala hi ko hai. Ab to tum apne mein se kisi ko apni yeh chaandi de kar shehar bhejo, woh khoob dekh bhaal le ke shehar ka kaun sa khaana paakeeza-tar hai, phir usi mein se tumhare khaane ke liye le aaye, aur woh bahut ehtiyaat aur narmi barte aur kisi ko tumhari khabar na hone de.
ayahs.20: Agar yeh kaafir tum par ghalba pa len to tumhein sangsaar kar den ge ya tumhein phir apne deen mein lauta len ge aur phir tum kabhi bhi kaamyaab na ho sako ge.
ayahs.21: Hum ne is tarah logon ko un ke haal se aagah kardiya ke woh jaan len ke Allah ka wada bilkul sachcha hai aur qayamat mein koi shak-o-shubha nahin. Jab ke woh apne amr mein aapas mein ikhtilaaf kar rahe the, kehne lage ke un ke ghaar par ek imaarat bana lo. Un ka Rabb hi un ke haal ka ziyada aalim hai. Jin logon ne un ke baare mein ghalba paaya woh kehne lage ke hum to un ke aas paas masjid banaayen ge.
ayahs.22: Kuchh log to kahen ge ke Ashaab-e-Kahf teen the aur chautha un ka kutta tha. Kuchh kahen ge ke paanch the aur chhata un ka kutta tha, ghaib ki baaton mein atkal (ke teer tukke) chalaate hain, kuchh kahen ge ke woh saat hain aur aathwaan un ka kutta hai. Aap keh dijiye ke mera parwardigar in ki tadaad ko ba-khoobi jaanne wala hai, unhen bahut hi kam log jaante hain. Pas aap in ke muqadme mein sirf sarsari guftagu karen aur in mein se kisi se in ke baare mein poochh-gachh bhi na karen.
ayahs.23: Aur hargiz hargiz kisi kaam par yun na kehna ke main use kal karoonga.
ayahs.24: Magar saath hi InshaAllah keh lena. Aur jab bhi bhoole, apne parwardigar ki yaad kar liya karna aur kehte rehna ke mujhe poori umeed hai ke mera Rabb mujhe is se bhi ziyada hidayat ke qareeb ki baat ki rahbari kare.
ayahs.25: Woh log apne ghaar mein teen sau saal tak rahe aur nau saal aur ziyada guzare.
ayahs.26: Aap keh den Allah hi ko un ke thehre rehne ki muddat ka ba-khoobi ilm hai, aasmanon aur zameenon ka ghaib sirf usi ko haasil hai, woh kya hi achha dekhne sunne wala hai. Siwaaye Allah ke un ka koi madadgaar nahin, Allah Taala apne hukm mein kisi ko shareek nahin karta.
ayahs.27: Teri jaanib jo tere Rabb ki kitaab wahi ki gayi hai use padhta reh, is ki baaton ko koi badalne wala nahin, tu is ke siwa hargiz koi panah ki jagah na paaye ga.
ayahs.28: Aur apne aap ko unhi ke saath rakha kar jo apne parwardigar ko subah shaam pukaarte hain aur usi ke chehre ke iraade rakhte hain (razaamandi chahte hain), khabardaar! Teri nigahen un se na hatne payen ke dunyawi zindagi ke thaat ke iraade mein lag ja. Dekh is ka kehna na maanna jis ke dil ko hum ne apne zikr se ghaafil kardiya hai aur jo apni khwahish ke peechhe pada hua hai aur jis ka kaam hadd se guzar chuka hai.
ayahs.29: Aur eilaan karde ke yeh sarasar bar-haq Quran tumhare Rabb ki taraf se hai. Ab jo chahe imaan laaye aur jo chahe kufr kare. Zaalimon ke liye hum ne woh aag taiyaar kar rakhi hai jis ki qanaaten unhen gher len gi. Agar woh faryaad-rasi chahen ge to un ki faryaad-rasi is paani se ki jaayegi jo tel ki talchhat jaisa hoga jo chehre bhoon dega, bada hi bura paani hai aur badi buri aaraam-gaah (dozakh) hai.
ayahs.30: Yaqeenan jo log imaan laayen aur nek aamaal karen to hum kisi nek amal karne wale ka sawaab zaaya nahin karte.
ayahs.31: Un ke liye hameshgi wali jannaten hain, un ke neeche nehren jaari hongi, wahan yeh sone ke kangan pahnaaye jaayen ge aur sabz rang ke narm-o-baareek aur mote resham ke libaas pahnen ge, wahan takhton ke oopar takiye lagaaye hue honge. Kya khoob badla hai, aur kis qadar umda aaraam-gaah hai.
ayahs.32: Aur unhen in do shakhson ki misaal bhi suna de jin mein se ek ko hum ne do baagh angooron ke de rakhe the aur jinhen khajooron ke darakhton se hum ne gher rakha tha aur donon ke darmiyan kheti laga rakhi thi.
ayahs.33: Donon baagh apna phal khoob laaye aur is mein kisi tarah ki kami na ki aur hum ne un baaghon ke darmiyan nehr jaari kar rakhi thi.
ayahs.34: Algharaz is ke paas mewe the, ek din is ne baaton hi baaton mein apne saathi se kaha ke main tujh se ziyada maaldaar aur jatthe ke eitbaar se bhi ziyada mazboot hoon.
ayahs.35: Aur yeh apne baagh mein gaya aur tha apni jaan par zulm karne wala. Kehne laga ke main khayaal nahin kar sakta ke kisi waqt bhi yeh barbaad hojaaye.
ayahs.36: Aur na main qayamat ko qaaim hone wali khayaal karta hoon aur agar (bil-farz) main apne Rabb ki taraf lautaaya bhi gaya to yaqeenan main (is lautne ki jagah) is se bhi ziyada behtar paaon ga.
ayahs.37: Is ke saathi ne is se baaten karte hue kaha ke kya tu is (mabood) se kufr karta hai jis ne tujhe mitti se paida kiya, phir nutfe se, phir tujhe poora aadmi bana diya.
ayahs.38: Lekin main to aqeeda rakhta hoon ke wahi Allah mera parwardigar hai, main apne Rabb ke saath kisi ko shareek na karoonga.
ayahs.39: Tu ne apne baagh mein jaate waqt kyun na kaha ke Allah ka chaaha hone wala hai, koi taaqat nahin magar Allah ki madad se, agar tu mujhe maal-o-aulaad mein apne se kam dekh raha hai.
ayahs.40: Bahut mumkin hai ke mera Rabb mujhe tere is baagh se bhi behtar de aur is par aasmaani azaab bhej de to yeh chatiyal aur chikna maidan ban jaaye.
ayahs.41: Ya is ka paani neeche utar jaaye aur tere bas mein na rahe ke tu use dhoond laaye.
ayahs.42: Aur is ke (saare) phal gher liye gaye, pas woh apne is kharch par jo is ne is mein kiya tha apne haath malne laga aur woh baagh to aundha ulta pada tha aur (woh shakhs) yeh keh raha tha ke kaash! Main apne Rabb ke saath kisi ko bhi shareek na karta.
ayahs.43: Is ki himaayat mein koi jamaat na uthi ke Allah se is ka koi bachaao karti aur na woh khud hi badla lene wala ban saka.
ayahs.44: Yahin se (saabit hai) ke ikhtiyaraat Allah bar-haq ke liye hain, woh sawaab dene aur anjaam ke eitbaar se bahut hi behtar hai.
ayahs.45: Un ke saamne dunya ki zindagi ki misaal (bhi) bayan karo jaise paani jise hum aasman se utaarte hain is se zameen ka sabza mila jula (nikla) hai, phir aakhir-kaar woh chura chura hojaata hai jise hawaayen udaaye liye phirti hain. Allah Taala har cheez par qaadir hai.
ayahs.46: Maal-o-aulaad to dunya ki hi zeenat hai, aur (haan) albatta baaqi rehne wali nekiyan tere Rabb ke nazdeek az-roo-e-sawaab aur (aainda ki) achhi tawaqqo ke bahut behtar hain.
ayahs.47: Aur jis din hum pahaadon ko chalaayen ge aur zameen ko tu saaf khuli hui dekhega aur tamaam logon ko hum ikattha karen ge, in mein se ek ko bhi baaqi na chhoden ge.
ayahs.48: Aur sab ke sab tere Rabb ke saamne saf-basta haazir kiye jaayen ge. Yaqeenan tum hamare paas isi tarah aaye jis tarah hum ne tumhein pehli martaba paida kiya tha, lekin tum to isi khayaal mein rahe ke hum hargiz tumhare liye koi wade ka waqt muqarrar karen ge bhi nahin.
ayahs.49: Aur naama-e-aamaal saamne rakh diye jaayen ge. Pas tu dekhega ke gunahgaar is ki tehreer se khaufzada ho rahe honge aur keh rahe honge, haaye hamari kharaabi, yeh kaisi kitaab hai jis ne koi chhota bada baghair ghere ke baaqi hi nahin chhoda, aur jo kuchh unhon ne kiya tha sab maujood paayen ge aur tera Rabb kisi par zulm-o-sitam na karega.
ayahs.50: Aur jab hum ne farishton ko hukm diya ke tum Aadam ko sajda karo to Iblees ke siwa sab ne sajda kiya, yeh jinnon mein se tha, is ne apne parwardigar ki nafarmaani ki, kya phir bhi tum use aur is ki aulaad ko mujhe chhod kar apna dost bana rahe ho? Halaanke woh tum sab ka dushman hai. Aise zaalimon ka kya hi bura badal hai.
ayahs.51: Main ne unhen aasmanon-o-zameen ki paidaaish ke waqt maujood nahin rakha tha aur na khud in ki apni paidaaish mein, aur main gumraah karne walon ko apna madadgaar banaane wala bhi nahin.
ayahs.52: Aur jis din woh farmaaye ga ke tumhare khayaal mein jo mere shareek the unhen pukaaro! Yeh pukaaren ge lekin in mein se koi bhi jawab na dega, hum in ke darmiyan halaakat ka saamaan kar den ge.
ayahs.53: Aur gunahgaar jahannam ko dekh kar samajh len ge ke woh usi mein jhonke jaane wale hain lekin is se bachne ki jagah na paayen ge.
ayahs.54: Hum ne is Quran mein har har tareeqe se tamaam ki tamaam misaalen logon ke liye bayan kardi hain lekin insan sab se ziyada jhagdaalu hai.
ayahs.55: Logon ke paas hidayat aa chukne ke baad unhen imaan laane aur apne Rabb se istighfaar karne se sirf isi cheez ne roka ke agle logon ka sa maamla unhen bhi pesh aaye ya un ke saamne khullam-khulla azaab aa-maujood hojaaye.
ayahs.56: Hum to apne Rasoolon ko sirf is liye bhejte hain ke woh khushkhabriyan suna den aur dara den. Kaafir log baatil ke sahaare jhagadte hain aur (chahte hain ke) is se haq ko ladkhadaayen, unhon ne meri aayaton ko aur jis cheez se daraaya jaaye use mazaaq bana daala hai.
ayahs.57: Is se badh kar zaalim kaun hai? Jise is ke Rabb ki aayaton se naseehat ki jaaye woh phir munh mode rahe aur jo kuchh is ke haathon ne aage bhej rakha hai use bhool jaaye, be-shak hum ne un ke dilon par parde daal diye hain ke woh use (na) samajhen aur un ke kaanon mein giraani hai, go tu unhen hidayat ki taraf bulaata rahe, lekin yeh kabhi bhi hidayat nahin paane ke.
ayahs.58: Tera parwardigar bahut hi bakhshish wala aur mehrbaani wala hai, woh agar in ke aamaal ki saza mein pakde to be-shak unhen jald hi azaab karde, balke un ke liye ek wade ki ghadi muqarrar hai jis se woh sarakne ki hargiz jagah nahin paayen ge.
ayahs.59: Yeh hain woh bastiyan jinhen hum ne un ke mazaalim ki bina par ghaarat kardiya aur un ki tabaahi ki bhi hum ne ek miaad muqarrar kar rakhi thi.
ayahs.60: Jab ke Moosa ne apne naujawaan se kaha ke main to chalta hi rahoonga yahan tak ke do daryaaon ke sangam par pahunchoon, khwaah mujhe saalha saal chalna pade.
ayahs.61: Jab woh donon darya ke sangam par pahunche, wahan apni machhli bhool gaye jis ne darya mein surang jaisa apna raasta bana liya.
ayahs.62: Jab yeh donon wahan aage badhe to Moosa ne apne naujawaan se kaha ke la hamara khaana de, hamein to apne is safar se sakht takleef uthaani padi.
ayahs.63: Is ne jawab diya ke kya aap ne dekha bhi? Jab ke hum patthar se teak laga kar aaraam kar rahe the wahin main machhli bhool gaya tha, dar-asl shaitan ne hi mujhe bhula diya ke main aap se is ka zikr karoon. Is machhli ne ek anokhe taur par darya mein apna raasta bana liya.
ayahs.64: Moosa ne kaha yehi tha jis ki talaash mein hum the, chunaanche wahin se apne qadmon ke nishaan dhoondte hue wapas laute.
ayahs.65: Pas hamare bandon mein se ek bande ko paaya, jise hum ne apne paas ki khaas rahmat ata farma rakhi thi aur use apne paas se khaas ilm sikha rakha tha.
ayahs.66: Is se Moosa ne kaha ke main aap ki tabedaari karoon? Ke aap mujhe is nek ilm ko sikha den jo aap ko sikhaaya gaya hai.
ayahs.67: Is ne kaha aap mere saath hargiz sabr nahin kar sakte.
ayahs.68: Aur jis cheez ko aap ne apne ilm mein na liya ho is par sabr bhi kaise kar sakte hain?
ayahs.69: Moosa ne jawab diya ke InshaAllah aap mujhe sabr karne wala payen ge aur kisi baat mein, main aap ki nafarmaani na karoonga.
ayahs.70: Is ne kaha achha agar aap mere saath hi chalne par israar karte hain to yaad rahe kisi cheez ki nisbat mujh se kuchh na poochhna jab tak ke main khud is ki nisbat koi tazkira na karoon.
ayahs.71: Phir woh donon chale, yahan tak ke ek kashti mein sawaar hue, to is ne kashti ke takhte tod diye, Moosa ne kaha kya aap use tod rahe hain taake kashti walon ko dubo den, yeh to aap ne badi (khatarnaak) baat kardi.
ayahs.72: Is ne jawab diya ke main ne to pehle hi tujh se keh diya tha ke tu mere saath hargiz sabr na kar sake ga.
ayahs.73: Moosa ne jawab diya ke meri bhool par mujhe na pakdiye aur mujhe apne kaam mein tangi mein na daaliye.
ayahs.74: Phir donon chale, yahan tak ke ek ladke ko paaya, is ne use maar daala, Moosa ne kaha ke kya aap ne ek paak jaan ko baghair kisi jaan ke ewaz maar daala? Be-shak aap ne to badi na-pasandeeda harkat ki.
ayahs.75: Woh kehne lage ke main ne tum se nahin kaha tha ke tum mere hamraah reh kar hargiz sabr nahin kar sakte.
ayahs.76: Moosa (alaihis salaam) ne jawab diya agar ab is ke baad main aap se kisi cheez ke baare mein sawaal karoon to be-shak aap mujhe apne saath na rakhna, yaqeenan aap meri taraf se (hadd) uzr ko pahunch chuke.
ayahs.77: Phir donon chale, ek gaaon walon ke paas aa kar un se khaana talab kiya to unhon ne un ki mehmaandaari se saaf inkaar kardiya, donon ne wahan ek deewaar paayi jo giraahi chahti thi, is ne use theek aur durust kardiya, Moosa (alaihis salaam) kehne lage agar aap chahte to is par ujrat le lete.
ayahs.78: Is ne kaha bas yeh judaai hai mere aur tere darmiyan, ab main tujhe in baaton ki asliyat bhi bata doonga jis par tujh se sabr na ho saka.
ayahs.79: Kashti to chand miskeenon ki thi jo darya mein kaam-kaaj karte the. Main ne is mein kuchh tod-phod karne ka irada kar liya kyunke in ke aage ek baadshah tha jo har ek (saheeh saalim) kashti ko jabran zabt kar leta tha.
ayahs.80: Aur is ladke ke maan baap imaan wale the. Hamein khauf hua ke kahin yeh unhen apni sarkashi aur kufr se aajiz-o-pareshaan na karde.
ayahs.81: Is liye hum ne chaaha ke unhen un ka parwardigar is ke badle is se behtar paakeezgi wala aur is se ziyada mohabbat aur pyaar wala bachcha inaayat farmaaye.
ayahs.82: Deewaar ka qissa yeh hai ke is shehar mein do yateem bachche hain jin ka khazana in ki is deewaar ke neeche dafan hai, in ka baap bada nek shakhs tha to tere Rabb ki chaahat thi ke yeh donon yateem apni jawaani ki umr mein aa kar apna yeh khazana tere Rabb ki mehrbaani aur rahmat se nikaal len, main ne apni raaye se koi kaam nahin kiya, yeh thi asal haqeeqat in waaqiaat ki jin par aap se sabr na ho saka.
ayahs.83: Aap se Zul-Qarnain ka waaqia yeh log daryaaft kar rahe hain, aap keh dijiye ke main un ka thoda sa haal tumhein padh kar sunaata hoon.
ayahs.84: Hum ne use zameen mein quwwat ata farmaayi thi aur use har cheez ke saamaan bhi inaayat kardiye the.
ayahs.85: Woh ek raah ke peechhe laga.
ayahs.86: Yahan tak ke sooraj doobne ki jagah pahunch gaya aur use ek daldal ke chashme mein ghuroob hota hua paaya aur is chashme ke paas ek qaum ko bhi paaya, hum ne farma diya ke aye Zul-Qarnain! Ya to tu unhen takleef pahunchaaye ya un ke baare mein tu koi behtareen ravish ikhtiyaar kare.
ayahs.87: Is ne kaha ke jo zulm karega use to hum bhi ab saza den ge, phir woh apne parwardigar ki taraf lautaaya jaayega aur woh use sakht-tar azaab dega.
ayahs.88: Haan jo imaan laaye aur nek aamaal kare is ke liye to badle mein bhalaai hai aur hum use apne kaam mein bhi aasani hi ka hukm den ge.
ayahs.89: Phir woh aur raah ke peechhe laga.
ayahs.90: Yahan tak ke jab sooraj nikalne ki jagah tak pahuncha to use ek aisi qaum par nikalta paaya ke in ke liye hum ne is se aur koi oat nahin banaayi.
ayahs.91: Waaqia aisa hi hai aur hum ne is ke paas ki kul khabron ka ihaata kar rakha hai.
ayahs.92: Woh phir ek safar ke saamaan mein laga.
ayahs.93: Yahan tak ke jab do deewaaron ke darmiyan pahuncha, in donon ke pare is ne ek aisi qaum paayi jo baat samajhne ke qareeb bhi na thi.
ayahs.94: Unhon ne kaha aye Zul-Qarnain! Yaajooj Maajooj is mulk mein (bade bhaari) fasaadi hain, to kya hum aap ke liye kuchh kharch ka intezaam karden? (Is shart par ke) aap hamare aur in ke darmiyan ek deewaar banaden.
ayahs.95: Is ne jawab diya ke mere ikhtiyaar mein mere parwardigar ne jo de rakha hai wahi behtar hai, tum sirf quwwat-taaqat se meri madad karo. Main tumhare aur in ke darmiyan band banaata hoon.
ayahs.96: Mujhe lohe ki chaadaren la do. Yahan tak ke jab in donon pahaadon ke darmiyan deewaar baraabar kardi to hukm diya ke aag tez jalaao, ta-waqt-ke lohe ki in chaadaron ko bilkul aag kardiya, to farmaaya mere paas laao is par pighla hua taamba daal doon.
ayahs.97: Pas to un mein is deewaar ke oopar chadhne ki taaqat thi aur na un mein koi sooraakh kar sakte the.
ayahs.98: Kaha yeh sirf mere Rabb ki mehrbaani hai, haan jab mere Rabb ka wada aayega to use zameen-boos karde ga, be-shak mere Rabb ka wada sachcha aur haq hai.
ayahs.99: Is din hum unhen aapas mein ek doosre mein gadd-mad hote hue chhod den ge aur soor phoonk diya jaayega pas sab ko ikattha karke hum jama kar len ge.
ayahs.100: Is din hum jahannam ko (bhi) kaafiron ke saamne la khada kar den ge.
ayahs.101: Jin ki aankhen meri yaad se parde mein thin aur (amr-e-haq) sun bhi nahin sakte the.
ayahs.102: Kya kaafir yeh khayaal kiye baithe hain? Ke mere siwa woh mere bandon ko apna himaayati bana len ge? (Suno) hum ne to in kuffaar ki mehmaani ke liye jahannam ko taiyaar kar rakha hai.
ayahs.103: Keh dijiye ke agar (tum kaho to) main tumhein bata doon ke baitibar-e-aamaal sab se ziyada khasaare mein kaun hain?
ayahs.104: Woh hain ke jin ki dunyawi zindagi ki tamaam-tar koshishen bekaar hogayin aur woh isi gumaan mein rahe ke woh bahut achhe kaam kar rahe hain.
ayahs.105: Yehi woh log hain jinhon ne apne parwardigar ki aayaton aur is ki mulaaqaat se kufr kiya, is liye in ke aamaal ghaarat hogaye, pas qayamat ke din hum in ka koi wazan qaaim na karen ge.
ayahs.106: Haal yeh hai ke in ka badla jahannam hai kyunke unhon ne kufr kiya aur meri aayaton aur mere Rasoolon ko mazaaq mein udaaya.
ayahs.107: Jo log imaan laaye aur unhon ne kaam bhi achhe kiye yaqeenan in ke liye Al-Firdaus ke baaghaat ki mehmaani hai.
ayahs.108: Jahan woh hamesha raha karen ge, jis jagah ko badalne ka kabhi bhi in ka irada hi na hoga.
ayahs.109: Keh dijiye ke agar mere parwardigar ki baaton ke likhne ke liye samandar siyaahi ban jaaye to woh bhi mere Rabb ki baaton ke khatam hone se pehle hi khatam ho jaayega, go hum isi jaisa aur bhi is ki madad mein le aayen.
ayahs.110: Aap keh dijiye ke main to tum jaisa hi ek insan hoon, (haan) meri jaanib wahi ki jaati hai ke sab ka mabood sirf ek hi mabood hai, to jise bhi apne parwardigar se milne ki aarzoo ho use chahiye ke nek aamaal kare aur apne parwardigar ki ibaadat mein kisi ko bhi shareek na kare.
